text:
Browse icons   ·   Docs   ·   MCP   ·   Sponsor 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

---

1,500 free, open source animated icons for React, Vue, Angular and plain JavaScript. Every animation is hand-crafted and tuned to feel smooth, and plays the same in every framework.

Hover and imperative triggers, with configurable size, color and duration. Built on motion .

 Quick start

 

 

Icons animate on hover by default, and motion is bundled. Import from @animateicons/react/lucide or @animateicons/react/huge .

Prefer to own the code? Copy one icon into your project with npx animateicons add bell-ring .

 Other frameworks

The same icons and the same motion ship for more than React:

 Framework Package Docs 
 ---------------------------------------------- ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ ------------------------------------------------------ 
 Plain JS, web components, Svelte, Solid, Astro @animateicons/vanilla Plain JS 
 Vue 3 and Nuxt @animateicons/vue Vue 
 Angular 20, 21 and 22 @animateicons/angular Angular 

 Props

 Prop Type Default 
 ------------ --------- -------------- 
 size number 24 
 color string currentColor 
 duration number 1 
 isAnimated boolean true 
 className string - 

 Hover, click or both

 [!TIP]
 Use useIconHover to play an icon when a user hovers or clicks the button, link or card around it.

 

See the full docs for click, both and multiple icons.

 Documentation

 Topic What it covers Docs 
 -------- ---------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 React Props, Next.js, Server Components and types React 
 Examples Hover helper, buttons, inputs, cards and menus Examples 
 shadcn Add icons with the shadcn CLI shadcn 
 CLI Copy icons into your project with npx animateicons CLI 
 MCP Let AI agents search and add icons MCP 

Start with the introduction for everything else.

 Contributing

PRs adding icons are welcome. See CONTRIBUTING.md.

 License

MIT. Icon shapes are based on Lucide and Hugeicons, see the third-party notices.

install.title: Quick start
install.html:
pnpm add @animateicons/react

import { BellRingIcon } from "@animateicons/react/lucide";

export function Notifications() {
	return <BellRingIcon size={24} color="#f45b48" />;
}

Icons animate on hover by default, and motion is bundled. Import from @animateicons/react/lucide or @animateicons/react/huge.
